close_reason: Design decision recorded — NormalizedIter pre-trim is correct and worth defending.
description: NormalizedIter::new() pre-trims leading/trailing spaces before iteration by slicing bytes[start..end]. This ensures trailing spaces never emit a trailing space byte — they're simply excluded from the slice before the iterator begins. A contributor might suggest 'just trim at the end' or 'use strip_prefix/strip_suffix'; the pre-trim approach is simpler and avoids double-pass. The regression tests for trailing space and internal-then-trailing space patterns are correct guard rails.
title: NormalizedIter pre-trim design: correct and worth defending
